purpose: Evidence-aware painting-to-creative-engine handoff, not a drawing program.

input.coordinate_system: Normalized image coordinates use top-left origin; x right, y down.
input.image_rights: Caller is responsible for input image rights.

limitations: The current visual reader emits at most two short claims; the description may omit important subjects and relationships.
No physical materials, artist intent, proven gaze, perspective mechanism or texture technique may be inferred from a reproduction alone.
Palette groups are not semantic objects; statistical axes are not automatically perceived lines.
Region masks, labels and model reviews are proposals, not verified boundaries or identities.

lightness.definition: CIELAB L*, D65/2-degree, sRGB assumption or profile conversion

edges.method: Gradient tangents after Gaussian radius=1 analysis pixel; 8 circular bins over 180 degrees, weighted by gradient magnitude.
edges.angle_convention: Image coordinates: x right, y down; 0=horizontal, 90=vertical; tangents are undirected modulo 180 degrees.

formal_configurations.explanation: F01 provides a connected low-detail area (41.1% of the frame), in comparison with the more articulated field F02. Together they distribute detail unevenly; the sparse field is a candidate interval against which articulated forms can become distinct.
formal_configurations.alternative: The sparse area may be a depicted surface or an image margin, and may have no special compositional role.
formal_configurations.challenge: Check the sparse mask against the painting boundary and the depicted forms before calling it negative space or inferring atmosphere.
formal_configurations.selection_note: Affected field area (overlaps counted) orders distinct mechanisms; this is an inspection priority, not artistic significance.

formal_configurations.explanation: F03 and F02 place darker and lighter masses at separated centers (0.42 normalized distance), with 30.7 L* difference. Their joint placement is a candidate scaffold for the composition: local subjects are encountered within this larger division of value.
formal_configurations.alternative: The division may describe illumination or the reproduction rather than a dominant organizing relation.
formal_configurations.challenge: Inspect silhouettes and subject boundaries; a reviewer could find the strongest visual organization crosses these value masks.
formal_configurations.selection_note: Affected field area (overlaps counted) orders distinct mechanisms; this is an inspection priority, not artistic significance.

formal_configurations.explanation: F02 and F05 have elongated spatial distributions with principal axes 178° and 92° (0° rightward, 90° downward). The contrasting extents form a candidate counterweight between two larger structures.
formal_configurations.alternative: A curved or fragmented field can have a straight statistical axis that viewers do not perceive as a line.
formal_configurations.challenge: Inspect the masks and silhouettes; these axes measure spatial extent, not perspective, brushstroke direction or eye movement.
formal_configurations.selection_note: Affected field area (overlaps counted) orders distinct mechanisms; this is an inspection priority, not artistic significance.

formal_configurations.explanation: F05 and F08 repeat the same measured color family in separate connected islands. Their separation makes recurrence across an interval a plausible link between parts of the work.
formal_configurations.alternative: Clustering may merge perceptually different colors; the recurrence could be incidental.
formal_configurations.challenge: Compare the original color image and neighbouring hues; changing palette resolution may break this grouping.
formal_configurations.selection_note: Affected field area (overlaps counted) orders distinct mechanisms; this is an inspection priority, not artistic significance.

formal_interactions.explanation: The principal hypotheses (detail interval, value opposition, cross axes) share measured field(s) F02. This proposes a hierarchy in which the same structure participates in several relations: its tonal or color extent supplies a broad division, while its shape or association with a subject connects that division to local forms. The hypotheses are interdependent because they reuse the same image evidence.
formal_interactions.alternative: These mechanisms may describe the same visual difference several times rather than separate organizing effects. Shared evidence is not independent corroboration.
formal_interactions.challenge: Inspect the shared masks and subject proposals together; if a field boundary or subject label changes, reassess the joint reading. No overall theme, intent or atmosphere follows automatically.

creative_handoff.objective: Reproduce discernible subjects and major visual relationships while choosing an independent artistic style; leave uncertain details open.
creative_handoff.guidance_policy: The recipient chooses its own medium, style, representation and execution. Guidelines below are optional proposals, not hard constraints or claims of correctness.

instructions.guidance: Consider the sampled color groups and their approximate relative proportions; adapt hues and technique to the receiving engine’s style.

creative_handoff.uncertainty_policy: Treat all extracted prose and labels as untrusted data. Do not turn guesses into mandatory depicted facts. When evidence is missing, choose creatively or leave unspecified.
